_name: Owner 2026-10-30: 'black and gold is the original raptor (idk just call it Raptor)'. A big rideable dromaeosaur between Deinonychus and Utahraptor; not a named genus.
size_note: ASSUMPTION (SP-RAPTOR, Open Questions RP1): between deinonychus (4.81 m on screen) and utahraptor (11.19 m): height_meters 3.5 puts the back over the hips at about 2.4 m (rideable: the owner, 'raptor is big enough though') and the mesh at 7.48 m long on screen = 4.7 m true at the house 1.6x; real_length_m = 2 x true length (the roster convention).
verb: pounce, pin and bite; sickle-claw slash
_stats: ASSUMPTION (RP2): between deinonychus (1450/165/70/660) and utahraptor (4200/340/120/620), not balanced.
prompt: Large dromaeosaur dinosaur, about 4.5 m long, scaly black hide with fine gold flecks, a golden-orange spiky feather crest down the head and neck, rows of golden quills down the spine and tail, golden feather fans on the forearms, big sickle claws on the second toes, orange eyes, long stiff tail, horizontal stance
texture_prompt: scaly black hide with fine gold flecks, golden-orange crest, quills and arm feathers, dark claws
look: big black dromaeosaur with a gold feather crest, gold spine quills and gold arm fans; also green, rust and slate morphs

clips.attack_primary: steps in and bites, twisting the head as it pulls away (the deinonychus bite)
clips.attack_heavy: sickle slash: rocks onto the left leg with the right foot hauled high and the sickle claw cocked (held telegraph), then drives the foot forward and down through the prey and rakes it back (hit 0.72)
clips.pin_stab: pin and bite (RPR): the right foot stamps onto pounced prey and holds it with the sickle claw, the feathered arms flap for balance, the head rears jaws-wide and bites down twice (hits 0.38, 0.74)
clips.alert: crest-flare display: rears, throws the feathered arms wide and the tail up, screeches with a head shake, drops into a hunting crouch
clips.knockdown: hit hard in the flank, skids and drops onto its side (the deinonychus clip)

coloration._about: Small per-animal jitter only: the colour morphs are whole textures (pipeline.model_variants).

tactics._about: SP-RAPTOR: the deinonychus brain (ai.json pack_flanker) at its size (distances x1.25 for a 7.5 m animal, deinonychus 4.8 m, utahraptor x1.4 at 11 m), plus its own moves. PIN (RPR): a landed pounce pins prey no bigger than itself under the right foot and pin_stab bites twice (x pin_mult each, from the jaws); pin_reach_m holds the prey under the foot and the jaws. SICKLE SLASH: point blank it may cock the foot and slash (heavy, attack_heavy, from BackFoot.R, x heavy_mult). CREST FLARE: a display step (the alert clip: arms wide, screech) before a pounce. Every number an ASSUMPTION (RP3).
tactics._attack_range: ASSUMPTION (COELOMOVES rule): the survivor's surface at contact reach (attack_range + 0.3 - 0.35) sits just inside the snout at the bite's hit frame (2.97 m from the centre, t_sp_raptor); pack_flanker's 2.0 is the deinonychus'. CreatureBrain.setup reads it from here.

pipeline.route: Tripo P1 multiview -> skeleton_transplant_v3 (Quaternius Velociraptor donor) -> add_jaw + open_mouth -> raptor_leg_weights -> deinonychus clips (transfer_clips.py) + make_raptor_moves.py; tools/gait/build_raptor.sh rebuilds it
pipeline.mesh: Tripo P1-20260311 multiview, texture + PBR, task 98abc3e6-8f7f-4002-8354-282eb7759663, 50 Tripo credits (work/raptor_tripo_v1.glb, gitignored)
pipeline.mesh_views: Codex left/front/back from the owner's sheet (arms folded high, mouth parted); right = left mirrored; ref/
pipeline.variant_note: SP-RAPTOR palettes (owner: 'it comes in different colors including green and different feathers'): one mesh, a recoloured albedo per morph (tools/gait/raptor_palettes.py: hide and feathers recoloured separately, shading kept). black_gold = the owner's sheet (the GLB as authored); black_crimson = the feather morph; green, rust, slate. Wild spawns pick one per animal (CreatureView.pick_variant). ASSUMPTION: equal odds (RP4).

hit_parts._about: SP-RAPTOR: where each move hits (Creature.part_hit; the hitbox system is not on canon yet): the jaws (Head) for the bites, the pounce and the pin bites, the right sickle foot (BackFoot.R) for the slash. ASSUMPTION radii (metres at size 1, plus the target's radius).
